content.text: Really common at 5, and it usually shifts with a calm, boring routine. Tonight, tell Milo the plan ahead of time at bedtime: "If you wake up, you walk back to your bed and I'll tuck you in again." When he does show up, walk him straight back with as little talk as you can, every time. Pair that with a small reward in the morning, like a sticker, for staying in his own bed.
